PINAL FOR PUBLICATION

Narrative and Plans for the
Type | Rezoning of 4508 S. Cottage Grove
from a B1-1 District to a B2-3 District

The subject property is currently vacant. The applicant needs a zoning change to meet the
bulk and density standards to build a new mixed-use building with seven dwelling units. The
applicant is seeking a type 1 map amendment per section 17-13-0303-D optional administrative
adjustment, specifically a parking reduction per section 17-10-0102-B. The parking requirement
will be reduced from seven spaces to 1 space for this transit served location.

A. Proposed Land Use: To rezone from a B1-1 District to a B2-3 District to build a new 4-
story mixed-use building with seven dwelling units and ground floor commercial.

B. The proposed building area will be 11,560 SF with a floor area ratio (FAR) of 2.70.

C. The lot area is 4,270 SF and its density is 610 SF per dwelling unit.

D. Amount of off-street parking is one space. The applicant will seek TSL parking relief.

E. Proposed setbacks:

Front — 0’

Side — 0°

Side — 0’

Rear — 30°

F. Proposed building height is 50”.
